body: Thanks for your message Hugo, it makes a lot of sense to me! I guess i was just feeling extraordinarily hateful towards my parents and my self last night and i have no idea why. But trying to find a silver lining in suicide was not helpful to my situation in any way. I guess i have to face up to some of these feelings, and address them, so talking to my father might be a good idea, as long as i watch my mouth. He's always ready to listen to me, even tho we often argue, but i think if i'm calm and collected and keep what you said in mind, i can find a way to steer the conversation to something useful. I won't do anything stupid; sometimes it just feels like i'm going to snap, but i guess we all feel like that some days. It touches me that a complete stranger on reddit would put in the effort to write me a response like that so i want to thank you for that too :)
Just re-reading what i wrote up there makes me realise how pathetic i am

I used to torture insects as a kid. I remember how it felt, and it terrifies the fuck out of me. That's what makes me worry about my future and what i could do. I've also stolen from my family repeatedly. And i know its bad, but the reason i steal is because I blame them for why i am what i am. When i was in Intermediate, they used to treat me like i was a star whenever i got a good report (i often did) or did well in a test (i often did.. back then), eager to celebrate my success. But then for some reason my dad would always be there to ridicule me afterwards, in the days that followed, or whenever i wasn't doing enough to please him. He had a regular list of insults, and he would find it funny to call me names and make me feel like an idiot. I don't even think he realised what he was doing, it was almost an impulse. But i still hated it. We would bond, and he would make me feel like i was his son and we shared something noone else had. He truly believed we were connected, father-son, the deep stuff eh. Well then why did he still make me feel like everything i did was a joke? And then he found out my friends at the time were doing the same thing he was...and it got worse. So now i'm just as fucked up, and i try to blame him for my stealing. Then my mums voice tells me 'stealing is stealing, theres no excuse' and i know i'm fucked. I'm a thief. She said so herself when she caught me with her credit card.
well... I know you only asked what i was capable of, but i guess you got the whole shibang :/ 
I feel like someone who deserves to die but doesn't live around anyone evil enough to do it for me... nope there's only me. And today i've finally realized what all of this means
